title: Hawaii Children's Discovery Center

services.name: Programs
services.desc: Childhood is a time when early learners acquire many of the skills they will need to become productive, happy adults. We offer part-day programs year around designed to give a fun, educational experience to your toddlers and preschoolers, 18 months to 5 years old. Our classes are run by museum and classroom educators and will spark your keiki’s curiosity, allow them to interact with peers, and give them a memorable first-time classroom experience. Toddler Time is an early childhood program for toddlers ages 18-36 months and their caregivers. services.name: General Admission
services.desc: Rainforest Adventures teaches children about the importance of rainforests around the world and right here in Hawai‘i. Through hands‑on exploration, keiki learn about our precious natural resources, island ecosystems, and why caring for the environment matters. The exhibit also includes our Little Explorers area, designed especially for children from birth to age 3. With safe, age‑appropriate activities and sensory play, it’s the perfect space for toddlers to discover, explore, and learn at their own pace.
